text: Meritocratic allocation of power in open source projects is often a fallacy, because rank can reflect timing and one-off contributions, deflation is not built into the perception of merit, and free riding on past reputation is therefore possible.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859

isBasedOn.name: Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades

abstract: In other words, deflation is not built into the perception of merit and free riding is possible.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies where rank is awarded on perceived merit and not periodically revisited
